client_process_memory.peak_scope: process lifetime; multiple candidates require fresh processes for comparison
client_process_memory.scope: client and in-process dashboard; excludes provider processes and OS file cache

communication_per_token.decode_scope: online bodies after first output through completion, divided by N-1
communication_per_token.denominator: authoritative generated output tokens, not input tokens or output cap
communication_per_token.scope: covered application bodies; no full wire or checkpoint download
communication_per_token.setup_scope: startup and discarded warmups charged once to measured-run output tokens

traffic_decomposition.law: total = known base + known output-dependent + unattributed; unused material is included, not added
traffic_decomposition.lifecycle_scope: startup charged once to first warmup or first measured request; repeats exclude startup
traffic_decomposition.packed_boundary_convention: only whole-cohort serialized payload bytes classified; shared phase-boundary bytes stay residual
traffic_decomposition.rate_scope: workload-specific output-dependent average, not constant next-token marginal cost

attribution.residual_scope: mixed preparation envelopes, padding, shared packed phase-boundary bytes, correction acknowledgements, lifecycle controls and unclassified phases

traffic_decomposition.scope: measured directed all-link serialized application bodies; not TCP stream or physical wire

summary.scope: measured run windows only; cold startup and discarded warmups reported separately

unmeasured: HTTP/TLS/transport framing and retries outside audit coverage
checkpoint distribution and pre-positioned artifacts outside measured links
exact unused output material bytes unless directly measured

limitations: diagnostic record, not a canonical EvidenceReport
does not establish model quality, energy, price, adversarial security, or non-collusion
Final-only token disclosure buffers all output; TTFT measures final disclosure and emission/decode TPS is unsupported.
FuseFSS final-disclosure timing includes source admission and offline preprocessing inside the SDK call; online-only elapsed time is unmeasured.

memory_guard.scope: 0.25-second host pressure samples; not a peak client-memory measurement

reasons: selected runtime requires native role owners; Docker is not admitted

estimate.scope: conservative allocation estimate; not measured peak RSS
estimate.tensor_storage: private complete-prefix recomputation; no persistent KV
estimate.weight_storage: public original IEEE to exact nearest-even ring50/Q12

native_process_memory.limitations: sampling can miss short peaks; shared pages may count in more than one process; excludes OS file cache and GPU allocations not charged to process RSS
native_process_memory.scope: same-window sum of client/dashboard and live provider RSS, startup through responses; includes native relay and sampler

privacy_admission.reason: loopback workers share one operator and host

process_cpu_accounting.scope: dashboard/client CPU from benchmark startup and role CPU from process birth; through the first cold measured response
unmeasured: source resolution before dashboard startup, if any
